planOwner: DWG_DXF_OPEN_SOURCE_PARITY_PLAN.md bounded AC1024 MLINESTYLE source/output profile

source.fixtureDisposition: Existing local source outside the repository. Used for the focused physical selector and strict CLI trace; no DWG/DXF fixture was added, modified, staged, or committed.

authority.title: Open Design Specification for .dwg files
authority.scope: Dictionary graph roles are checked independently from the parser's common-link span-validation marker.

finding.before: The physical AC1024 MLINESTYLE selector wrote the selected style but did not qualify its retained source frame. Strict CLI stopped at 225/228 opaque callbacks.
finding.cause: prepareDwgMLineStyles treated hasDwgCommonLinkTail() == true as a profile rejection for every version. DRW_Dictionary::parseDwg sets this marker after the AC1021+ common links and counted item handles have been decoded within the frame and their roles checked. The predicate rejected successful validation.
finding.after: Root-owner admission now requires the marker to match the source-version expectation: false for the admitted AC1015/AC1018 legacy profiles and true for source versions after AC1018. Exact NOD/root entry, owner, reactor, typed baseline, and source-frame checks remain in place. Debug export reports the specific MLINESTYLE profile gate when a bounded source is skipped.
finding.strictCli: At the time of this slice, opaque output qualification advanced from 225/228 to 226/228. The debug finalizer printed remaining decimal handles 34 and 89, which are DWG handles 0x22/type 82 (Model) and 0x59/type 82 (Layout1); S27 subsequently qualified those bounded profiles and strict conversion of the exact source succeeded. This MLINESTYLE slice alone did not qualify whole-file AC1024 conversion.

implementation.productionChange: Require version-appropriate DICTIONARY common-link validation instead of rejecting the validated AC1024 tail. Keep all existing exact source-role and graph checks.
implementation.selectorChange: The physical selector exports through the same dx_iface that imported the DWG, matching dwg2dxf and retaining session-bound source evidence. It verifies ASCII and Binary output, a bad linetype-index refusal with sentinel destination preservation, same-adapter retry, source/owner opaque output qualification, and fresh DXF readback.

physicalSelector.result: PASS for ASCII and Binary. Fresh readback verifies the STANDARD style identity, two BYLAYER sentinel elements, and rooted owner/reactor output. An injected unresolved linetype index is refused without replacing the sentinel destination; restoration and retry on the same adapter succeed.

strictCli.result: EXPECTED_FAIL_CLOSED at this historical S26 checkpoint; 226/228 opaque callbacks qualified. The debug finalizer printed decimal handles 34 and 89, which are DWG handles 0x22/type 82 (Model) and 0x59/type 82 (Layout1). S27 later qualified these exact rooted output profiles and strict conversion of the exact source succeeded.

limits: The receipt qualifies only the selected AC1024 STANDARD MLINESTYLE source graph and emitted DXF profile on this local sample.
No broad AC1024 or whole-drawing support claim is promoted.
next: S27 later qualified the exact rooted Model/Layout1 profiles on this source and enabled strict conversion. Continue the remaining independent-reader, native-consumer, and version/profile qualification gates; do not infer broad AC1024 support from this selected MLINESTYLE slice.
